candidates.description: This feature vector represents Greek letters and mathematical variables commonly used in scientific and technical notation.
This feature vector activates on subword tokens containing Thai script characters.
This feature vector activates on a random, heterogeneous assortment of unrelated subword tokens and Thai characters without a cohesive semantic theme.
This vector activates on a random collection of unrelated multilingual text fragments and noise tokens without a cohesive semantic theme.
This feature detects open parenthesis characters and specific Thai script fragments or comparative terms.
This vector represents common Thai linguistic subunits and subword tokens.
These tokens represent subwords or fragments commonly found in Thai text encoding.
The tokens represent common Thai prepositions and locative terms indicating spatial or conceptual placement.
This feature vector activates strongly on Thai script characters, sub-word tokens, and related linguistic text.
This feature vector represents the Thai script character "ล" (lo ling) and its various phonetic, sub-word, and tokenized representations across multilingual contexts.
